board.name: Missouri State Board of Registration for the Healing Arts (Advisory Commission for Physician Assistants)

licence.title: Physician Assistant license
licence.renewalCycleNote: Board instructions say all PA licences expire January 31 and renewal information is mailed each year; RSMo 334.738.3 says a licence is valid for two years and may be renewed annually. Treat as annual renewal by January 31 until the Board confirms.
licence.renewalDeadline: January 31 (forms postmarked February 1 or later are delinquent)

ce.hoursNote: No state CME hour count found in 20 CSR 2150-7 or RSMo 334.735 to 334.749. Continued licensure rests on active NCCPA certification (statutory definition of physician assistant), which carries NCCPA's own CME and recertification exam cycle.
ce.nccpaNote: RSMo 334.735.1 defines a physician assistant as a person who has passed the NCCPA exam and has active NCCPA certification.
ce.controlledSubstanceCe: None found in Missouri PA statute or rules.

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: Written collaborative practice arrangement required before practice; PA must inform the Board in writing of the collaborating physician's name and practice address(es) before practising; any change reported within 15 days; arrangement reviewed at least annually and kept 8 years after termination (not filed with the Board).
practice.notes: Collaborating physician reviews at least 10% of charts (20% of controlled substance prescriptions) with documentation submitted at least every 14 days, and is present at least once every two weeks where the PA diagnoses and initiates treatment (telehealth allowed). Before prescribing controlled substances when the physician is not on site, the PA completes 120 hours in a four-month period practising with the collaborating physician on site.

prescribing.stateCsRegistrationNote: Missouri Bureau of Narcotics and Dangerous Drugs (BNDD) registration plus DEA.
prescribing.separateAuthorityNote: Certificate of controlled substance prescriptive authority from the Board of Healing Arts (advanced pharmacology course, 300 clock hours of clinical prescribing training with the collaborating physician, one year of supervised practice or rotations). Schedule III to V; Schedule II limited to hydrocodone products (and Schedule II for certified hospice patients); Schedule III narcotics and Schedule II hydrocodone limited to a 120-hour supply without refill; buprenorphine for medication-assisted treatment up to 30 days. 120 hours in four months practising with the collaborating physician on site before prescribing controlled substances when the physician is not on site.

rn.ceNote: The RN renewal rule (20 CSR 2200-4.020(8)) asks for fee and workforce data only; no RN continuing education requirement was found.

aprn.title: APRN licence (certified nurse practitioner)
aprn.renewalNote: Runs concurrent with the Missouri or multistate RN licence; APRN must provide primary source evidence of recertification by an approved certifying body before the current expiration date.
aprn.ceNote: No state hour count for certified APRNs; national recertification is the renewal evidence. Uncertified APRNs approved before January 1, 2010 instead need 800 practice hours and 60 contact hours every two years.

prescribing.separateAuthorityNote: Certificate of controlled substance prescriptive authority from the Board of Nursing: advanced pharmacology (or 3 credit hours or 45 CE units of pharmacology within 5 years), 300 clock hours preceptorial prescribing experience, 1,000 hours of APRN practice after graduation, and CS authority delegated in a collaborative practice arrangement.
prescribing.pharmacologyCeForPrescribers: None per cycle found; 45 pharmacology CE units within 5 years is one way to meet the initial pharmacology requirement.
prescribing.stateCsNote: BNDD registration after the Board grants CS prescriptive authority, plus DEA.

practice.authorityNote: Label follows the AANP taxonomy (not a primary source). Primary fact: APRN practice requires a written collaborative practice arrangement with a physician under RSMo 334.104.
practice.transitionToPracticeHours: One month practising with the collaborating physician continuously present before practising where the physician is not continuously present (exceptions for population-based public health and certain primary care or behavioral health pairings). Separately, 1,000 hours of APRN practice before a certificate of controlled substance prescriptive authority.
practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: Not filed with the Board of Nursing. Signed before implementation, reviewed at least annually with documentation kept in the arrangement, retained 8 years after termination; the collaborating physician reports arrangements to the Board of Healing Arts within 30 days of a change and at each physician renewal. Chart review: 10% of services (20% of CS prescriptions) every 14 days.

unverified: MO PA renewal cycle length: RSMo 334.738.3 says a licence is 'valid for two years' and 'may be renewed annually'; Board instructions say all PA licences expire January 31 with renewal information mailed each year. Recorded as annual with verified:false; confirm with the Board before building a reminder.

MO PA: no state CME hour requirement exists in 20 CSR 2150-7 or RSMo 334.735 to 334.749; active NCCPA certification is part of the statutory definition (RSMo 334.735.1(7)). The renewal form (MOPRO portal, login only) was not loaded, so whether the Board checks NCCPA status at each renewal is not confirmed.
MO RN: absence of an RN CE requirement is inferred (renewal rule and Board renewal page list no CE); no Board text states it outright.
MO NP practice authority label 'restricted' is the AANP classification; primary sources establish mandatory written collaborative practice arrangements (RSMo 334.104; 20 CSR 2200-4.200).
MO BNDD registration renewal interval for PAs and APRNs was not researched; only the duty to register (RSMo 334.747.1; 20 CSR 2200-4.100(4)) is confirmed.

corrections: MO PA practice.agreementType: quote replaced with an exact contiguous passage from 20 CSR 2150-7.135(2) (the original used an ellipsis). Value unchanged.

MO PA: added statutory chart review (10% of charts every 14 days, 20% of controlled substance charts, RSMo 334.735.9), physician presence at least once every two weeks, 8-year retention, the 120-hour (5-day) supply limit for Schedule III narcotics and Schedule II hydrocodone, and the 30-day buprenorphine allowance, each from a loaded primary source.

MO NP rn.renewalCycleYears and rn.renewalDeadline: cite '20 CSR 2200-4.010(1)(H)4' could not be matched to that subsection label in the loaded PDF; recorded as 20 CSR 2200-4.010 (renewal schedule item 4). Values (biennial, April 30 of odd years) confirmed.
MO NP practice.chartReview: quote corrected to the exact rule text ('a review of a minimum of ten percent'); the researcher's quote dropped 'a minimum of'. Value unchanged.

MO NP rn.nlcCompactMember: weak quote ('The party states find that:') replaced with 20 CSR 2200-4.100(5)(A)1, which recognises a multistate privilege for APRN renewal; RSMo 335.360 (effective July 20, 2017) re-loaded and kept as the compact citation.

MO NP: added RN renewal window (February 1 to April 30, odd years) and no grace period from the Board renewal page, the APRN duty to have recertification received before expiry, the uncertified-APRN renewal rule as a fact (800 hours, 60 contact hours), and the statutory exceptions to the one-month continuous presence rule.

MO both professions: re-checked 20 CSR 2150-7 (current SOS file dated 9/30/25), 20 CSR 2200-4 (file dated 4/30/24 and 6/30/24) and RSMo 334.735, 334.738, 334.747, 334.104, 335.019 (all effective 8/28/2023 or earlier versions noted). No CE topic mandate (opioid, implicit bias, human trafficking, child abuse, ethics, HIV, end of life, Alzheimer, suicide prevention, infection control, cultural competency, domestic violence) appears for PAs or APRNs; none added. Federal one-time 8-hour DEA training added for both.
